text.p: Monterey Resources Inc said it has a definitive agreement to acquire McFarland Energy Inc at a cash price of $18.55 per share.
The total value of the transaction was not immediately available. However, McFarland has about 5.72 million shares outstanding.
The terms of the merger agreement were unanimously approved by both companies' boards of directors at meetings held on Monday.
The deal is expected to be accretive to earnings and cash flow, Monterey Chairman and Chief Executive R. Graham Whaling said in a statement.

McFarland has current daily production of about 3,700 barrels of oil and five million cubic feet of gas. Total proved reserves for McFarland are currently estimated by Monterey Resources at about 20 million oil equivalent barrels.
Monterey has current production of about 50,000 barrels of oil per day. It has proved reserves of about 218 million oil equivalent barrels at the end of 1996.
